name: CMAC 서브키 RFC 4493 (§12.1)
script:
def dbl(x: bytes) -> bytes:
    rb = h"00" * (len(x) - 1) + (h"87" if len(x) == 16 else h"1b")
    r = x << 1
    if x[0] & 0x80 != 0:
        r ^= rb
    return r

k1 = dbl(l)
k2 = dbl(k1)
